## Current checkpoint — 22 November 2026

**Full Collatz remains OPEN.** This checkpoint adds **65 Lean-checked public theorems in six modules**, complete written proofs, and exact finite arithmetic. It connects the newest source-induction, finite-potential, and ordinary-boundary developments.

The refresh inventoried all **122 open and 23 closed PRs** and studied the seven branches advanced since the previous checkpoint: PR175, PR176, PR177, PR178, PR182, PR183, and PR185. Exact heads, paths, normalization, and ownership are recorded in each note. This is not a new proof audit of all repository history.

### 1. A stronger source induction and an exhausted valuation-two family

Every supplied complete source with grade list G satisfies S <= 2^(sum G). At equal grade, a larger supplied source therefore decreases the natural defect 2^(sum G)-S. The new Lean induction interface justifies this source tie together with the smaller-original-target tie; its complete dispatcher remains explicit.

This permits the exact same-grade rewrite:

- [3,4,2] -> [2,3,4], with odd source q -> q+4, unchanged initial exponent, and the identical complete tail.

Additional strict-grade surgeries include [3,1] -> [3], [3,2,1] -> [3], and (initial exponent 2, [3,4,1]) -> (initial exponent 3, [3,3]). All retain an actual supplied suffix and enlarge the known source.

Within the repository's explicit source/target induction, the new final frontier discharges valuation t=1, all t>=4, and **every low-gap t=2 instance** of the failed head-three phase. The t=2 proof exhausts its parameter classes using those surgeries and the exact ordinary descent:

\[
T^{13}(8192h+4199)=6561h+3364<8192h+4199.
\]

The remaining formal alternative retains the complete supplied certificate and has:

\[
q=256j+173,\quad u=96j+65,\quad c=2187j+1478,
\]
\[
\mathrm{word}=[2,2]++\mathrm{tail},\qquad
54j+37\xrightarrow{\mathrm{tail}}1.
\]

It supplies Basin(c), but the implication to Basin(6c+1) on this domain remains open. General non-psi interval targets also still need a complete dispatcher.

A further **written** arbitrary-length rewrite
[3]++[2]^k++[4,1] -> [2,4]++[2]^(k-1)++[1,3], k>=1,
raises q to q+4 at the same grade and retains the literal tail. Additional written surgeries/descent leave only j=1 mod4, j=2 mod4, or j=4 mod8 unclassified inside the formal t=3 frontier. These refinements are distinguished from the 29 formal witness theorems.

### 2. An intrinsic computable inverse horizon

Exact finite rational matrices sum the entire legal valuation series. With D_s=P^s 1 and

\[
\epsilon_m=3^{-2m}\sum_{a\bmod3^{2m}}
|D_{2m}(a)-D_m(a\bmod3^m)|,
\]

an actual unit predecessor floor b>=9^m through depth K gives

\[
\max_{s\le K}D_s(q)/q
\le4^m/b+K(5K+4)\epsilon_m/m.
\]

An ordinary all-gap-one cylinder proves
epsilon_m >= 2(4^(-m)-(2/9)^m) >= (2/9)4^(-m)>0.
Thus H*_m=max{H:H^4 epsilon_m<=1} is finite and exactly computable without a positive regularizer. Tao's cited marginal mixing theorem gives superpolynomial growth of this one sequence; the cylinder also gives H*_m <= (9/2)^(1/4) 2^(m/2).

The finite obstacle extension V_k <= sum_(j<=k)D_j yields

\[
V_k(q)/q\le H_m^*4^m/b+9/(mH_m^*),\qquad k+1\le H_m^*.
\]

This finite estimate needs no population theorem, stationary normalization, or infinite majorant. A violation at q>=b gives an actual unit ancestor below b within the actual witness depth. An early witness for every survivor, or another all-depth bound at a fixed floor, is still missing.

### 3. One finite reference for every forward/contact clock

On the nonperiodic ordinary unit domain, keep the actual forward mass operator L, kill on entering any periodic state, and retain the upstream analytic qualifications. Let ell(q) count strict future contacts V<=2 and eta_j be the harmonic mass on contact layer j.

The new exact Green identity is S eta_j(q)=nu(q) 1_(ell(q)<=j).
For c_j=(j+1)^(-1/2)-(j+2)^(-1/2), kappa=3 exp(-200/3)/4, set

\[
\sigma_*=d+\kappa\sum_j c_j\eta_j.
\]

This reference is finite and everywhere positive, with

\[
S\sigma_*=\nu-\lambda h+
\kappa\nu/\sqrt{\ell+1}\le\nu.
\]

Let Pi be actual inverse first contact, including time zero, and retain every original n^-4 source label. For the complete projected source a and original-label truncation a_N, explicit constants K,M give

\[
\Pi L^k a\le M\sigma_*,\qquad
\Pi L^k(a-a_N)\le2K N^{-1/2}\sigma_*
\quad\text{for every }k\ge0.
\]

The actual densities converge strongly in every finite Lp(sigma_*), with complete original-source tails. Their limit records escaping component mass; it is not proved zero. The note also extends the occupation-dominated source class and all-frequency residues to every finite p>1, crediting the prior quadratic results.

[Full ordinary-boundary theorem](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/ab3973099f0d285bbe88972382ad599bb02cd460/research/lean-joint-20261122/ORDINARY_BOUNDARY.md)

The additional clock theorem proves why Pi L^k cannot be replaced by (Pi L)^k. On escaping last contacts, each reset changes the actual component clock by 1-tau. Every ordinary unit has a noncontact parent in the 17 mod27 class; unchanged-clock retries are geometric. Repeated resets therefore drive the clock to minus infinity almost surely and have no nonzero finite stationary measure there. This preserves the exact composition boundary.

[Contact-clock proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/ab3973099f0d285bbe88972382ad599bb02cd460/research/lean-joint-20261122/CONTACT_CLOCK.md)
